q.t: To divide AB in the ratio 3 : 5, at least how many equal marks are needed on the ray AX?
q.e: The ratio needs 3 + 5 = 8 equal parts in all.

q.t: To draw tangents from an outside point P to a circle with centre O, the first step is to…
q.e: A circle on OP as diameter cuts the given circle where the angle in a semicircle is 90° — exactly where the tangents touch.

q.t: Triangle ABC is drawn again with scale factor 2/3. The new triangle is…
q.e: A scale factor below 1 shrinks every side.

q.t: A triangle with a 6 cm side is drawn with scale factor 5/3. How long is that side in the new triangle?
q.e: Multiply by the scale factor: 6 × 5/3.

q.t: A 10 cm segment AB is divided in the ratio 2 : 3. Find AP.
q.e: AP is 2 of 5 equal parts: 10 × 2/5.

q.t: In dividing a segment, the lines through the marks on ray AX are drawn…
q.e: Parallel lines cut AB in the same ratio as they cut AX (Basic Proportionality Theorem).

q.t: What angle is formed in a semicircle (in degrees)? This is used when drawing tangents.
q.e: An angle in a semicircle is always a right angle.

q.t: A triangle with an 8 cm side is drawn with scale factor 3/4. How long is that side now?
To draw a triangle similar to a given one with scale factor 7/3, how many equal marks are made on the ray?
q.e: Mark the larger of the two numbers, 7, so that both 3 and 7 are available.

q.t: When a triangle is redrawn with a scale factor, its angles…
o: are multiplied by the scale factor
q.e: Similar triangles have equal angles; only the sides change.

q.t: A 7.5 cm segment is divided in the ratio 2 : 3. Find the shorter part.
A triangle with sides 4, 5, 6 cm is drawn with scale factor 3/2. Find its longest side.
A triangle has perimeter 24 cm. A similar triangle is drawn with scale factor 5/4. Find its perimeter.
q.e: Each side grows by 5/4, so the perimeter does too.

q.t: A triangle is redrawn with scale factor 2/3. new area : old area =
q.e: Area scales with the square of the length factor.

q.t: Tangents are drawn from a point 10 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 6 cm. Find the tangent length.
To draw a triangle similar to ΔABC with scale factor 4/7, points B₁ … B₇ are marked on a ray from B. Which two points are joined first?
q.e: Join the last mark B₇ to C, then draw a parallel through B₄; it cuts BC at 4/7 of its length.

q.t: A 12 cm segment is divided in the ratio 5 : 7. Find the longer part.
Dividing a segment in a given ratio by drawing parallel lines works because of…
q.e: A line parallel to one side of a triangle cuts the other two sides in the same ratio.

q.t: Two tangents to a circle are at 60° to each other. Find the angle between the radii to the points of contact.
q.e: The quadrilateral of centre, two contact points and the outside point has two 90° angles: 360° − 180° − 60°.

q.t: Two tangents are to be drawn at 45° to each other. At what angle (in degrees) should the two radii be drawn?
q.e: Angle between radii = 180° − angle between tangents.

q.t: AB = 9 cm is divided at P so that AP : PB = 4 : 5. Find PB.
A triangle of area 27 cm² is redrawn to have area 48 cm². What scale factor was used?
q.e: Area ratio 48/27 = 16/9, so the length factor is √(16/9).

q.t: Tangents are drawn from a point P with OP = 2r (twice the radius). Find the angle between them.
q.e: sin(half-angle) = r/OP = 1/2, so the half-angle is 30°.

q.t: To divide AB in the ratio 3 : 4, a ray AX has 7 equal marks A₁ … A₇. A₇ is joined to B. Through which mark is the parallel drawn?
q.e: The point dividing AB in 3 : 4 corresponds to the 3rd of the 7 marks.

q.t: A right triangle with legs 5 and 12 cm is redrawn with scale factor 7/5. Find the new area.
q.e: Old area 30; area scales by (7/5)² = 49/25.

q.t: Find the tangent length from a point 7 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 3 cm.
Which step comes first when drawing tangents from P to a circle with centre O?
o: Join O and P and bisect OP
Draw a radius perpendicular to OP
Draw a circle centred at P
q.e: The midpoint of OP is the centre of the helping circle that finds the touching points.

q.t: AB = 8 cm is divided at P in the ratio 3 : 5. How far is P from the midpoint of AB?
q.e: AP = 3 cm and the midpoint is 4 cm from A.

q.t: In ΔABC, AB = 4.5 cm. A similar triangle is drawn with scale factor 2/3. Find the new AB.
ΔABC has angles 50° and 60°. It is redrawn with scale factor 3/5. Find the third angle of the new triangle.
q.e: Angles do not change on scaling: 180° − 50° − 60°.

q.t: Tangents are drawn from a point 8 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 4 cm. Find the length of each.
AB = 14 cm is divided in the ratio 3 : 4, and the larger part is then halved. Find the length of each half.
q.e: The larger part is 14 × 4/7 = 8, and half of it is 4.

q.t: A triangle is redrawn with scale factor 5/3, and that one is redrawn with scale factor 3/5. Find final area : original area.
q.e: The two factors multiply to 1, so it is the same size again.

q.t: A right triangle with legs 6 and 8 cm is redrawn with scale factor 3/4. Find the new hypotenuse.
q.e: The old hypotenuse is 10; 10 × 3/4.

q.t: To draw ΔA′BC′ with scale factor 3/7 of ΔABC, a parallel through B₃ to B₇C meets BC at C′. Find BC′ : C′C.
q.e: BC′ is 3 of 7 parts of BC; the rest, C′C, is 4 parts.

q.t: The two tangents from P to a circle of radius 5 cm are at right angles. Find OP.
q.e: OAPB is a square of side 5, and OP is its diagonal.

q.t: A triangle is redrawn so that its area doubles. What scale factor was used?
q.e: Area scales with the square of the factor, so k² = 2.

q.t: Tangents 15 cm long are drawn from P to a circle of radius 8 cm. Find the area of the quadrilateral formed by the two tangents and the two radii.
q.e: Two right triangles, each ½ × 8 × 15.

q.t: AB = 12 cm is divided in the ratio 5 : 3 using 8 marks, with the parallel drawn through A₅. Find AP.
From a point 10 cm from the centre, tangents touch a circle of radius 6 cm at A and B. Find the length of AB.
q.e: The tangent is 8. AB is cut in half by OP; half of AB = (8 × 6)/10, the height of the right triangle on OP.
